keyEvents.text: Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Mario Martín (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Carlos Maciá (Villarreal).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Getafe. Ramón Terrats replaces Mario Martín.
Nemanja Gudelj (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Villarreal. Ayoze Pérez replaces Alberto Moleiro.
Substitution, Villarreal. Santi Comesaña replaces Carlos Maciá.
Substitution, Villarreal. Alex Freeman replaces Santiago Mouriño.
Santi Comesaña (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Renato Veiga (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Villarreal. Nicolas Pepe replaces Tani Oluwaseyi.
Goal! Villarreal 1, Getafe 0. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner. Assisted by Nicolas Pepe with a cross.
Substitution, Getafe. Iván Azón replaces Orel Mangala.
Substitution, Getafe. Francho Serrano replaces Enes Ünal.
Substitution, Getafe. Kiko Femenía replaces Andrés García.
Substitution, Villarreal. Nathan Saliba replaces Georges Mikautadze.
Goal! Villarreal 2, Getafe 0. Carlos Romero (Villarreal) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ayoze Pérez with a through ball.
